name: Big Buttons
author: Chris Pinkham (CaptainMurdoch)
description: This plugin displays multiple big buttons in a grid on a page.  Each button can be individually configured to run a different user script.  The title and color of each button can also be configured.

privacy.summary: Adds a page of big buttons to the player's web interface. Each button runs an action from the player's own list or opens a web address, and can also send that action to other FPP players you pick.

sends.to: the other FPP players you pick
sends.what: the button's command and its settings
sends.why: to run the same action on those players

privacy.other: Your button layout is kept in a settings file on the player and is not removed if you uninstall the plugin. A button can do anything the player's own action list allows, including running a script you wrote. Nothing is recorded about who pressed a button.
